title: Outland Cave - Hoyo Negro, Aktun-Hu (A. Nava Blank)
credits: Outland Cave, Aktun-Hu Cave System, Ejido Jacinto Pat, Quintana Roo, Mexico; cartography by Alberto Nava Blank. Another edition of the same plan (map-3.jpg, "Outland Cave, Sac Aktun Cave System", (c) 2012 Alberto Nava Blank): all passages and profiles surveyed with depth computer, compass, ScubaPro sonar, tape and knotted line, November 2012 to May 2014, by Alex Alvarez, Franco Attolini, Alberto Nava, Roberto Chavez, Sam Meacham, Susan Bird; distance surveyed 3,814 ft, max depth surveyed 161 ft; reference position 20 18' 54.7" N, 87 25' 52.6" W (WGS84).
placementWhy: Good (about 20-40 m): the map's own 150 m scale bar (0.904 m/px) and north up, shifted onto Outland (dive log, taken on site: 20.31186, -87.426865) at the La Virgen pond - the database's La Virgen (map source) is 18 m from Outland, and the QRSS 2012 overview (sac-actun-mpo-tulum) puts its Outland dot at this same passage end. Checks: (1) Concha (Open Caves source) is 55-70 m NE of the map's La Concha end, which the map draws as continuing (faded, dotted) towards it - the overview shows the same continuation; (2) a free similarity fit (ICP) of the traced walls onto the QRSS 2012 overview's lines gives scale x0.984, rotation 0.8 deg and a 42 m shift north at the centroid, median 13 m apart - within that overview's own 50-60 m residuals; the Hoyo Negro hub, the W, S, N-loop and E branches all fall on the overview's; (3) a canopy gap on the Maxar imagery, elongated SW-NE like the Oasis pond outline, lies 20-30 m E/SE of the map's Oasis pond. No free fit on two points: Concha's spot is off the map, and the database's Hoyo Negro and Ich Balam (Gerrard) are not trusted. Hoyo Negro lands at 20.31513, -87.43256 and Ich Balam at 20.31511, -87.43169. The database's Hoyo Negro (20.31519, -87.43128) is 134 m E of the map's pit - it equals the reference position printed on the other edition (map-3), which the map would put 45 m E of Ich Balam; the database's Ich Balam (20.31482, -87.42747) is on the N-S track 400 m E of the map's (its text says 60 m E of Hoyo Negro, 120 m past Outland on the road: likely the turn-off on the track, not the cenote). hoyo-negro-2012 was placed on that Ich Balam position and sits about 435 m E of this placement.
